test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The given diagram depicts the distribution of salaries per annum (in lakh) of the CEOs of six MNCs (C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03288f3306c6968e66032cc37e9c88fbde44dd045c29ec9bbd8f1d33ff1702a8.png] 

What is the difference of the salary drawn (in percentage) between the lowest and highest paid CEO?
solution:
**Given:**

Highest salary in C5 = 75 lakhs

Lowest salary in C6 = 50 lakhs 

**Calculation:**

Difference between the highest and lowest salary = 75 - 50 = 25 lakhs 

Difference percentage = 25/50 × 100 = 50%

**∴ The required percentage is 50%**
